maturityUsage.0: Chat questions only, no code generation on sensitive modules
maturityUsage.2: Chat with file context, small edits
maturityUsage.3: Agent mode on small, well-defined tasks
maturityUsage.4: Agent mode on normal tasks, review by risk
maturityUsage.5: Autonomous agents with budgets and guardrails

provenanceHint.measured: Counted by the internal AI gateway or the tool's telemetry
provenanceHint.declared: Reported by a provider or a Git signal, aggregated
provenanceHint.estimated: Computed from the size of the context

archViewHint.contexte: The system seen from outside: actors and third-party systems (C4 level 1)
archViewHint.conteneurs: The deployable units and what connects them (C4 level 2)
archViewHint.flux: Only the links that carry data, with the nature of the message
archViewHint.impact: Pick a node: the blast radius is highlighted by number of hops

pipelineVariableKind.project: To provide in the CI/CD settings

guidePhaseHint.prerequis: What must be installed on the workstation
guidePhaseHint.services: Database, messaging: what runs next to the application

setupPhaseHint.prerequis: What must already be installed on the workstation
setupPhaseHint.acces: Ask for these first: lead times, not commands, are what cost a week
setupPhaseHint.recuperation: Clone and move to the right place
setupPhaseHint.services: The dependencies that run next to the application
setupPhaseHint.configuration: The values that change from one workstation to another
setupPhaseHint.verification: Know that it works, without having to assume it

approval.title: No named approver for {env}
approval.detail: Promotion needs a manual approval, but the configuration names no role. In practice, whoever is free clicks.

waitDominates.title: Waiting for approval takes longer than the whole technical chain
waitDominates.detail: Machines need {machineMin} to reach {env}, and changes wait {waitMin} at the gates. Faster tests would change almost nothing.

nonBlocking.title: “{stage}” stops nothing
nonBlocking.detail: The step runs and publishes its result, but a failure lets the rest of the chain through. The report exists; the barrier does not.

realData.title: {env} holds real data with no security barrier
realData.detail: No blocking security step comes before this deployment: a commit can reach production data without any check able to stop it.

rollbackUntested.title: Rollback has never been rehearsed
rollbackUntested.detail: The procedure is written and announced at {durationMin}, but no rehearsal is recorded. The first time will be an incident.

noVerify.title: Nothing checks the deployment to {env}
noVerify.detail: The chain declares success as soon as the manifests are applied. Operations, or a user, will be the ones to find out the application does not start.

missing.title: No ticket justifies this change
missing.detail: Neither the branch, the title nor the commits cite a ticket: nobody asked for what is being delivered.

unavailable.title: Ticket could not be read
unavailable.detail: The ticket is cited but could not be read from the tracker: conformance cannot be checked.

notApproved.title: Specification not approved
notApproved.detail: The ticket's status is “{status}”: the business has not approved what is being delivered.

approvedByAuthor.title: Specification approved by the author of the change
approvedByAuthor.detail: The person delivering the code also approved the request: nobody else looked at it.

rewrittenByAuthor.title: Specification rewritten by the author after approval
rewrittenByAuthor.detail: The author of the change edited the ticket {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} after it was approved. The code is compared with the approved text, not the edited one.

changedAfterApproval.title: Specification changed after approval
changedAfterApproval.detail: The ticket changed {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} since it was approved, with no new approval.

notInSpec.title: Sensitive zone not covered by the specification
notInSpec.detail: The change touches a critical zone that the approved specification does not mention.

missing.title: Missing {role, select, business {business} techLead {tech lead} security {security} other {required}} approval
missing.detail: This critical zone requires a {role, select, business {business} techLead {tech lead} security {security} other {required}} approval; nobody with that role approved, the author excluded.

self.title: The author approved their own change

amountNotInSpec.title: Amount {to, number} not in the approved specification
amountNotInSpec.detail: The code sets a value that the approved specification does not mention.

amount.title: Amount {to, number} matches the specification
amount.detail: The new value appears in the approved specification.

authorization.title: Access rights changed
authorization.detail: Roles, permissions or authorisations: {added, plural, one {# line added} other {# lines added}}, {removed, plural, one {# removed} other {# removed}}.

validationRemoved.title: Checks removed
validationRemoved.detail: {count, plural, one {One check (exception, validation, assertion) is removed} other {# checks (exceptions, validations, assertions) are removed}} without a replacement.

hardcodedAccount.title: Bank account hardcoded ({account})
hardcodedAccount.detail: A valid IBAN appears in the code: a beneficiary should never be fixed in code.

unrequested.label: Shipped without request
unrequested.hint: Code on main that no approved ticket asked for.

notShipped.label: Requested, not shipped
notShipped.hint: Tickets closed in the tracker that never reached main.

changedAfterReview.label: Changed after review
changedAfterReview.hint: Code or spec that moved after the people accountable approved it.

agent.label: AI-agent changes
agent.hint: Code written by an AI agent without the human review it needs.

noTicket.title: Merged without a ticket
noTicket.detail: No ticket in the title, branch, description or commits: nobody in the business asked for this change.

directPush.title: Pushed straight to main
directPush.detail: This commit skipped the merge request: no review, no approval, no ticket check.

specNotApproved.title: Built from a ticket nobody approved
specNotApproved.detail: The ticket it cites never reached an approved status: the business did not sign off what was built.

mergedBlocked.title: Merged despite a blocked review
mergedBlocked.detail: Change control found {count, plural, one {# blocking issue} other {# blocking issues}}, and the merge went through anyway.

doneNotShipped.title: Closed in the tracker, not on main
doneNotShipped.detail: The business considers it delivered, but no merge or commit on main in the window cites it.

commitsAfterApproval.title: Changed after approval
commitsAfterApproval.detail: {count, plural, one {# commit was} other {# commits were}} added after the last approval: reviewers did not see the code that shipped.

specEditedAfterApproval.title: Spec edited after approval
specEditedAfterApproval.detail: The ticket changed after the business approved it: the code may follow a version nobody accountable agreed to.

specEditedAfterDelivery.title: Spec edited after delivery
specEditedAfterDelivery.detail: The ticket changed {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} after the code shipped: what runs may no longer be what is asked.

agentNoHumanReview.title: {agent} change with no human review
agentNoHumanReview.detail: Written by an AI agent and merged without any human approval.

agentCriticalZone.title: {agent} changed a critical zone
agentCriticalZone.detail: A human approved, but not every role the policy requires for this zone signed off this agent's change.
